macro_context.market_sentiment: Risk-on rebound on May 5 as U.S.-Iran truce held; Russell 2000 +1.41%, Nasdaq +0.90%, S&P 500 +0.78%. Market had sold off May 4 when UAE intercepted Iranian missiles and oil spiked. Tech sector leading intraday.
macro_context.fed_outlook: Fed held rates at 3.50%-3.75% on April 29 (8-4 vote) in Powell's final meeting as chair. One dissenter wanted a cut; three others opposed easing bias in the statement. Inflation elevated partly due to Middle East energy prices; next cut timing uncertain.
macro_context.geopolitical: Middle East conflict (Iran) is the primary risk — oil prices spiked May 4, partially reversed May 5 on truce. Ongoing U.S. tariff uncertainty, NATO/Greenland posturing, and Venezuela tensions add to headline risk. Chinese overcapacity a structural pressure.
key_events: U.S.-Iran truce status — any breakdown would spike oil and risk-off sentiment

ticker_news.headline: Nike declares $0.41 quarterly dividend payable July 1, 2026 — NKE gains premarket on dividend confidence

NKE stock down ~32% year-to-date, -29% over past three months amid poor sales, layoffs, and inventory issues

FY2026 EPS consensus ~$1.51 (down ~30% YoY); Q4 guidance implies 2%-4% revenue decline due to weak Greater China and Converse

analyst_consensus.recent_changes: Multiple downgrades in March-April 2026: CICC Research (outperform->market perform, PT $69->$58); Citigroup (neutral, PT $65->$53); DA Davidson (buy->neutral, PT $72->$46, April 2); Barclays raised PT to $73 (March 11 upgrade). Consensus per MarketBeat: 19 Buy / 16 Hold / 1 Sell, avg PT $63.25. Stock trades at ~$43, implying ~47% upside to consensus. Needham and HSBC also downgraded to hold earlier in 2026.

web_context.competitor_activity: Adidas is gaining lifestyle market share with Samba/Gazelle 'Terrace' trend and is ahead of its 4-year recovery plan, directly pressuring Nike's casual/lifestyle segment. Hoka and On Running continue to capture performance-running share, though Nike's running category grew +20% in Q3 FY26. Under Armour is restructuring (dropped Steph Curry sponsorship, targeting $45-50M savings) and is less of a competitive threat. Nike maintains dominant 27% athletic footwear market share vs Adidas 13%, but the lifestyle momentum gap is a near-term headwind.
web_context.earnings_info: Next earnings: June 25, 2026 (after market close, Q4 FY2026). FY2026 full-year EPS consensus ~$1.51 (down ~30% YoY). Q4 revenue guidance calls for 2%-4% sales decline driven by weakness in Greater China and Converse. Revenue estimate ~$44-45B for full fiscal year.
